Task name: Aurelian Skin - Ecommerce skincare image system
Sector: Clinical skincare and personal care, actives-led, direct to consumer plus specialty retail
Founded / place / size: Founded 2024 in Boston, Massachusetts. A two person founder team, sold for a year to a waiting list and through two dermatology practices before the retail season.
About: Aurelian Skin is a small clinical skincare line built on eight actives-led products at thirty four to sixty eight dollars. In March we open our own online store and enter a specialty chain's twelve doors, so everything a customer sees changes at once. The line is meant to read like a laboratory with good taste: cool, quiet, evidence first, generous with white space and free of decoration. Not a spa, not a discount aisle. Our customer reads the ingredient list before the copy, and the brand is built to reward that: honest claims, clear INCI, restraint in place of ritual.
Audience: Women roughly twenty six to forty two, ingredient literate, who research formulations and trust plainness over promise. They shop web stores and specialty beauty floors and judge a product by its panel.
Price positioning: Prestige-mass at thirty four to sixty eight dollars per SKU. Above the mass aisle, below luxury conserve pricing. The middle is the position, and the look must not drift warm and cheap or dark and precious.
Personality: Clinical, Precise, Restrained, Evidence-led, Understated

Typography: Aurelian's display face is Signifier Light from Klim, a rationalist serif that reads as instrument rather than apothecary. What a viewer notices first is the product name in Signifier Light capitals tracked to 340 units, with a 0.5 pt Graphite hairline ruled beneath at the exact measure of that name. Body is Söhne Buch 400; percentages, INCI and prices sit in Söhne Mono 400, tabular lining. Carton name 15 pt, INCI panel 6.5 pt; on screen name 44 px, claim 24 px, price 28 px, body 15 px on 22 px. Never rebuild the wordmark in a sans.
Signature type move: Product names are always Signifier Light capitals tracked to 340 units, sitting on a 0.5 pt Graphite hairline ruled to the exact measure of the name and nothing wider.
Voice: Measured, factual, unhurried. States what a product does and does not claim. Reads like a well-run lab that respects the reader, never breathless and never coy.
Values: Ingredient honesty, precision in every detail from panel to package, and clinical restraint: at this band, quiet and exact is the brand, and overstatement or gloss would undercut the claim.
Brand assets status: The original logo file was lost when the first designer's drive failed. All that survives is a handheld photograph of an outer carton showing the mark printed in one deep ink: a small-caps lockup set around a monogram, separated by a hairline rule. Recovering that mark as usable artwork is part of this engagement. No other source brand files remain.
